role: Postdoctoral Research Associate — public presentation: R&D Project Manager
summary: Led a €500,000 project to build, qualify and operate a complete iSCAT microscope.

projectType.label: Project type
projectType.value: Construction of a complete iSCAT microscope

paragraphs: The project was conducted at King’s College London to build, qualify and operate a complete iSCAT microscope.
It covered the entire experimental workflow, from the selection and procurement of optical and instrumental components through the design of protocols, samples and experiments.
The project represented €500,000 in funding from the BBSRC, with co-funding from Oxford Nanopore Technologies.

directContributions.label: Project leadership
directContributions.text: Led the project funded by the BBSRC and co-funded by Oxford Nanopore Technologies.

directContributions.label: Team
directContributions.text: Managed three doctoral researchers and two Master’s interns.

directContributions.label: Instrumentation
directContributions.text: Selected and procured the optical and instrumental components, assembled the optical table and qualified the complete microscope.

directContributions.label: Control and automation
directContributions.text: Developed the LabVIEW software used to control the instrument and automate experimental acquisitions.

directContributions.label: Experimental work
directContributions.text: Designed the protocols, samples and experiments, then implemented data acquisition.

directContributions.label: Scientific analysis
directContributions.text: Developed image-analysis and result-interpretation methods using Python, ImageJ macros and Java for ImageJ.

finalState.title: State at the end of the project
finalState.text: The iSCAT microscope was complete, qualified and operational, the LabVIEW control and automation software had been developed, the experimental workflow was established and the project had produced several scientific publications.
